body:
Reproduced faithfully on the reported commit 2726fb419b using the exact script, against a stock local service (pessimistic mode — confirmed via mo_transactions): ~4/5 runs produce the reported symptoms, verbatim —
  SHOW CREATE TABLE race_h → ERROR 20101: missing visibility metadata for index "ridx_3" and
  INSERT / REINDEX → ERROR 1146: no such table …__mo_index_secondary_<uuid>.
 
  On current main (f536057430) the same script does not reproduce in 15/15 runs. At the issue commit's ~80% hit rate that's 
  ~3e-11 if still broken, so it appears already fixed between 2726fb419b and current main. Candidate fixes in the window: 
  #29867, #29861, #29837, #29472. Recommend confirming the fixing PR and closing, or keeping open only to add a regression 
  test.
